info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Authorization Reversal-spec
info.description: The Authorization Reversal API allows businesses to reverse previously approved card authorizations efficiently. By providing the unique authorization ID, users can initiate a reversal process, ensuring that funds are released back to the customer's account. This API is particularly valuable for financial institutions and payment processors that need to manage and adjust authorizations due to cancellations or corrections. It facilitates smooth financial operations and enhances transaction management capabilities.

post.summary: Reverse a card authorization for a specific card.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to reverse a card authorization that has been previously made for a specific card. Ensure to provide the required details in the request body for the reversal to be processed successfully.
